title: 4773- Manager, CEO's Office
description:
**Go to Market at Innovaccer**

Our GTM team is passionate about healthcare and wants to leave a positive impact in the ecosystem. We are the tip of the spear that leads the organization externally. We care deeply about our customers and want to resolve their challenges with our solutions. If this excites you, let's chat about how you can help us tell our special story.

**About the Role**

As a Manager – CEO's Office, you will operate at the center of Innovaccer's strategic and operating core, working directly with the CEO and senior leadership to drive organizational priorities, special initiatives, and cross-functional execution. This role is built for someone who combines sharp analytical thinking with exceptional communication skills and thrives on translating ambiguous challenges into clear plans of action. You'll serve as a force-multiplier for the CEO — connecting dots across functions, ensuring the right decisions get made at the right speed, and driving accountability across the company's most important initiatives. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, operations, and leadership.

**A Day in the Life**

* Act as an extension of the CEO — prepare briefings, synthesize inputs, and ensure the CEO is always decision-ready with the right context
* Own the CEO's strategic operating cadence: leadership reviews, all-hands, board prep, and key stakeholder meetings
* Track and drive execution on the company's most critical cross-functional priorities and OKRs, surfacing blockers and recommending course corrections
* Lead high-priority special projects — from market opportunity assessments and M&A diligence support to organizational redesign and new initiative launches
* Draft, refine, and align executive communications including board materials, investor updates, internal memos, and town hall narratives
* Serve as a trusted liaison between the CEO and functional leaders — translating strategic intent into actionable workstreams and following through on outcomes
* Conduct research and analysis on competitive dynamics, industry trends, and strategic decisions to support CEO-level thinking
Identify and resolve organizational friction points that slow down decisions or execution  

  
  
**Requirements**  

* 3–5 years of experience in marketing operations, management consulting, or strategy roles—preferably in a SaaS, B2B, or data-driven environment.
* Strong analytical foundation with proficiency in Excel/Sheets, Salesforce, HubSpot (or similar CRM/marketing tools), and dashboarding platforms (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau).
* Proven experience working cross-functionally across sales, marketing, and operations teams.
* Excellent project management and communication skills.
* Self-starter mindset with bias for action, clarity, and results.
Strong understanding of funnel mechanics, pipeline stages, and campaign performance metrics  

  
  
**Benefits**

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

**Here’s What We Offer**

  

* Generous Leave Benefits: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* Parental Leave: Experience one of the industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical Leave Policy: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer health benefits and insurance to you and your family for medically related expenses related to illness, disease, or injury.
* Pet-Friendly Office\*: Spend more time with your treasured friends, even when you're away from home. Bring your furry friends with you to the office and let your colleagues become their friends, too. \*Noida office only
Creche Facility for children\*: Say goodbye to worries and hello to a convenient and reliable creche facility that puts your child's well-being first. \*India offices  

**Where and how we work**

Our Noida office is situated in a posh techspace, equipped with various amenities to support our work environment. Here, we follow a five-day work schedule, allowing us to efficiently carry out our tasks and collaborate effectively within our team.

Innovaccer is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

Disclaimer: Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.

title: Team Leader - Collections
description:
**ClickMyLoan**

**Company:** ClickMyLoan  
**Location:** Noida  
**Department:** Collections & Recovery  
**Experience:** 3–7 Years in Collections / Recovery / Telecalling  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Role Objective**

We are seeking a result-driven **Collection Team Leader** to manage and mentor a team of collection executives responsible for collections across delinquency buckets. The role involves driving daily collections, improving team productivity, ensuring compliance, and achieving recovery targets through effective call management and customer engagement.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in **tele-collections**, **team handling**, **collection analytics**, and **customer negotiation** within **NBFC / Fintech / Banking** environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Management & Productivity**

* Lead and manage a team of **10–30 collection executives / agents**.
* Allocate daily calling data and bucket-wise portfolios to team members.
* Set clear daily, weekly, and monthly recovery targets.
* Track team productivity and ensure target achievement.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions.

**2. Collection Operations**

* Drive collections across buckets:
* Monitor repayment follow-ups and overdue collections.
* Ensure timely customer contact and payment resolution.
* Improve collection efficiency and reduce delinquency.

**3. Call Monitoring & Quality Control**

* Monitor collection calls for quality and effectiveness.
* Improve key operational metrics:
* RPC (Right Party Contact)
* PTP (Promise to Pay)
* PTP Kept Ratio
* Conversion Rate
* Handle escalation calls and difficult customer cases.
* Train agents on objection handling and negotiation skills.

**4. MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare daily collection MIS and performance reports.
* Track:
* Recovery amount
* Agent productivity
* Bucket performance
* Payment trends
* Bounce / overdue status
* Share insights and escalation points with Collection Manager / Head.

**5. Compliance & Process Adherence**

* Ensure team follows **RBI Fair Practice Code** and company policies.
* Maintain ethical recovery practices.
* Ensure no harassment, abusive language, or compliance violation.
* Address customer complaints and escalations promptly.

**6. Process Improvement**

* Identify gaps in collection process and recommend improvements.
* Support implementation of:
* Dialer optimization
* WhatsApp / SMS reminder campaigns
* Automated follow-up workflows
* Help improve digital collection efficiency.

**Required Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
* **3–7 years** of experience in **Collections / Recovery / Telecalling**.
* Minimum **1–3 years in team handling / leadership role**.
* Experience in **Fintech / NBFC / Banking / Loan Collections** preferred.
* Strong understanding of:
* DPD buckets
* Collection lifecycle
* CRM / Dialer tools
* Recovery strategies
* Good communication and negotiation skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Team Leadership
* Tele-Collections
* Recovery Management
* Customer Negotiation
* Excel / MIS Reporting
* Call Auditing
* Problem Solving
* Conflict Resolution

**Success Metrics (KPIs)**

* Team Collection Efficiency (CE %)
* Daily / Monthly Recovery Achievement
* PTP Kept Ratio
* RPC %
* Agent Productivity
* Delinquency Reduction
* Compliance Audit Score

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

To support this evolving digital landscape, EY leverages Google Apigee, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure and DevOps automation to deliver secure, high\-performance and highly available API management platforms for mission\-critical business applications.

We are offering you a demanding role. You will use your advanced expertise in Google Apigee, Kubernetes, Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps Automation, API Security and Enterprise Architecture to deliver secure, scalable and highly available solutions for mission\-critical enterprise integrations and API ecosystems. This position provides opportunities to collaborate with global stakeholders and support API modernization, cloud transformation and operational excellence initiatives.

* Oversee Apigee platform architecture and implementation.
* Act as the primary escalation point for Apigee and platform issues.
* Design and support end\-to\-end platform migrations and modernization programs.
* Drive infrastructure automation, governance and security standards.
* Collaborate with networking, cloud, security and DevOps teams.

* Apigee X and Apigee Hybrid architecture
* Kubernetes platforms (GKE, EKS, AKS, and On\-Prem Kubernetes)
* Cloud platforms including GCP, AWS, and Azure
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
* API Security concepts including OAuth2, JWT, TLS, and mTLS
* CI/CD pipelines and APIOps implementation
* Monitoring and Observability using Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, and Splunk
* Disaster Recovery (DR), High Availability (HA), and Resiliency design
* Networking, Load Balancing, DNS, and Traffic Management
* Platform Governance, Security Controls, and Compliance Frameworks

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Effective stakeholder and client management skills
* Strong architecture and technical documentation expertise
* Presentation and solution demonstration skills
* Team\-player mindset with collaborative working style
* Self\-motivated and proactive attitude
* Ability to lead architecture reviews and design workshops
* Experience driving Proof of Concepts (POCs) and innovation initiatives
* Strong decision\-making and technical leadership capabilities
* Ability to work across global and cross\-functional teams

  


**To Qualify for the Role, you must have**

  


* 8 to 14 years of relevant experience in API Management, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or Enterprise Architecture
* Extensive hands\-on experience with Google Apigee (Apigee X and/or Apigee Hybrid)
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes operations and platform architecture
* Experience designing and implementing cloud\-native solutions on GCP, AWS, or Azure
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, IAM, and infrastructure services

* Hands\-on experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and APIOps practices

* Experience leading architecture design sessions, workshops, and technical governance reviews

* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-team collaboration experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
